newsitem.title: USA: NJ Resources says 2 pct price increase ok'd.
newsitem.headline: NJ Resources says 2 pct price increase ok'd.

text.p: New Jersey Natural Gas Co, the principal subsidiary of New Jersey Resources Corp, said on Wednesday its proposal to increase its Levelized Gas Adjustment Clause by $7.9 million, which will increase customer bills by about two percent, was approved by the Board of Public Utilities.
The increase will cover higher natural gas costs caused by last year's colder-than-normal weather, the company said.
Through the Levelized Gas Adjustment, most natural gas companies pass along increases or decreases in their cost of natural gas purchases, the company said.

The increase would raise the bill of a typical residential heating customer who uses 100 therms of gas from $79.48 to $81.19 per month, the company said. The increase does not impact the base rate the company charges customers for gas service.
